source: Dang et al. 2025 author repository at b2cbb61097cdc25bfff1e0a89ba690a31c2a4adc; derived from local CSV files

ex_vivo_interface_height_ols_0_to_6h_um_.estimand: front interface displacement along imaging axis, OLS over 0-6h

ex_vivo_bone_front_mean_cell_x_displacem.estimand: mean tracked-cell displacement in x along front-normal axis

ex_vivo_bone_front_cell_speed_magnitude_.estimand: Velocities_all_videos.csv individual speed magnitudes, different from x displacement

in_vivo_size_proxy.procedure: plot_results_with_data.Rmd: lin.size.um=sqrt(area)*1000; rate uses E13.5 to E14.0 and divides by 12h
in_vivo_size_proxy.boundary: whole-bone sqrt(area) growth is not a local moving-interface or material-frame speed; article figure caption reports n=7 per stage while this CSV has 8 rows, so rows are not assumed to be independent embryos

released_model_speed_estimands_um_per_h.boundary: different finite estimators/windows; none is a held-out nature validation

BAPN_source_observations.treatment: 1 g/kg BAPN-containing food from embryonic day E11.5; irreversible competitive LOX inhibitor per primary article
BAPN_source_observations.reported_direction: front stiffness decreases, bone-center stiffness mildly increases, collagen-fiber cross-sectional area changes, Osx1-GFP front-profile slope decreases, endpoint frontal-bone area increases
BAPN_source_observations.boundary: primary article does not report matched BAPN front speed or a PDE run with BAPN-mapped parameter changes; endpoint area is a qualitative perturbation consistency check, not validation of alpha or the front-speed equation
